evidence_set: Simonetto et al.: of 10 patients followed up, 60% stopped and had complete resolution, 30% did not abstain and continued to have symptoms and one had no improvement despite self-reported abstinence (Table 1 counts this series as 6 of 6); Allen et al.: 7 of 10 abstained and recovered, 3 did not and stayed ill, and all 3 patients who used cannabis again after a period of abstinence had a return of illness (Table 1 gives this series 9 patients).

Second-hand surveys of patients diagnosed with cyclic vomiting syndrome: of 31 patients, 72% reported hot showers as self-treatment and 42% used cannabis daily to weekly (Namin et al.); of 437 patients, 81% used cannabis and 67% used hot showers for relief (Venkatesan et al., reported in a journal supplement); of 20 patients, 12 used cannabis chronically and all took hot baths or showers (Oruganti et al.). The review reports no study that tested how well the proposed features separate the syndrome from cyclic vomiting syndrome.
